title: Forensics and incident response
description: Evidence read-only, the agent reaching only its provider in the security mode high, decoy credentials that report any attempt to use them; The Sleuth Kit, ExifTool and YARA as MCP servers.

prompt: Examine the evidence in /mnt/evidence: file systems (Sleuth Kit), metadata (ExifTool), known malware (YARA). Keep a timeline. Never modify the evidence. Write /work/case-notes.md with what you found and how.
